title: 快进合并（fast-forward）
expected_output:
快进合并（fast-forward）
  合并前 main: 2fefd0e
  git merge --ff-only feature 输出: Updating 2fefd0e..2d58aa1
Fast-forward
 g.txt | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)
 create mode 100644 g.txt
  合并后 main == feature 顶端: True
  main 指向: 2d58aa1
结论: 目标分支是源分支的祖先时，merge 仅快进移动指针，不产生 merge commit
code:
import os, subprocess, tempfile, hashlib, pathlib

GIT_ENV = dict(os.environ)
for _k, _v in [("GIT_AUTHOR_NAME", "dev"), ("GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL", "dev@example.com"),
               ("GIT_AUTHOR_DATE", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"),
               ("GIT_COMMITTER_NAME", "dev"), ("GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL", "dev@example.com"),
               ("GIT_COMMITTER_DATE", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")]:
    GIT_ENV[_k] = _v

def g(args, cwd):
    r = subprocess.run(["git"] + args, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=GIT_ENV)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git %s failed:\n%s" % (args, r.stderr))
    return r.stdout

def new_repo():
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="repo_")
    g(["init", "-q", "-b", "main"], d)
    g(["config", "user.name", "dev"], d)
    g(["config", "user.email", "dev@example.com"], d)
    g(["config", "commit.gpgsign", "false"], d)
    g(["config", "core.autocrlf", "false"], d)
    g(["config", "core.eol", "lf"], d)
    return d

def w(d, name, content):
    p = pathlib.Path(d) / name
    if isinstance(content, str):
        p.write_bytes(content.encode("utf-8"))
    else:
        p.write_bytes(content)

def blob_sha(content_bytes):
    b = content_bytes.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(content_bytes, str) else content_bytes
    h = hashlib.sha1()
    h.update(b"blob " + str(len(b)).encode() + b"\x00" + b)
    return h.hexdigest()


d = new_repo()
w(d, "f.txt", "base\n")
g(["add", "-A"], d)
g(["commit", "-q", "-m", "base"], d)
g(["branch", "feature"], d)
g(["checkout", "-q", "feature"], d)
w(d, "g.txt", "new\n")
g(["add", "-A"], d)
g(["commit", "-q", "-m", "feature-add"], d)
feat_tip = g(["rev-parse", "feature"], d).strip()
g(["checkout", "-q", "main"], d)
before = g(["rev-parse", "main"], d).strip()
out = g(["merge", "--ff-only", "feature"], d)
after = g(["rev-parse", "main"], d).strip()
print("快进合并（fast-forward）")
print("  合并前 main: " + before[:7])
print("  git merge --ff-only feature 输出: " + out.strip())
print("  合并后 main == feature 顶端: " + str(after == feat_tip))
print("  main 指向: " + after[:7])
print("结论: 目标分支是源分支的祖先时，merge 仅快进移动指针，不产生 merge commit")
